id.description: Stable lowercase ASCII kebab-case identifier, assigned once.

revision.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, array order preserved, and the root `revision` field omitted.

sha256.description: Full lowercase hex SHA-256 of the served bytes.

relativeUrl.description: URL relative to the configured catalog base URL. No scheme, no leading slash, no `..` or `.` segments, no backslashes, no query or fragment.

gainDb.description: Gain offset in dB. Bounded to keep playback safe.
